caption: The drawing features a single glass object centered within a rectangular frame. The object is a transparent, flared vessel with smooth, clean lines, resembling a vase or a drinking glass. The vessel widens towards the top and has a thick, rounded lip. Its stem is short and connects to a rounded, ring-like base that transitions to a wide, circular foot providing stability. The glass is depicted in varying shades of gray and white, with highlights and shadows illustrating its reflective surface and three-dimensional form. The background within the rectangular frame consists of a flat mid-gray tone, while the area outside the frame is a lighter, off-white color with some faint marks and natural paper texture visible.
title: Glass
